reviews.text: I very much want to like this game but in it's current state it feels very half baked even for early access. It is absolutely no way worth $20 when there are many games going into EA for much much less than that and are absolutely well fleshed out with a clear vision from the get go. I guess we'll see how this one turns out but I'm not too sure atm.

目前最远击杀第二个boss，总体评价是好评，挺不错的，看得出来制作组想塞蛮多内容在流派构筑上。 敌人血量又厚，伤害又高，因此很需要玩家的装备/遗物搭配妥当。我还玩得不深，目前只发现“单纯增加不同属性词条”的普通装备和拥有“特殊效果”的传说装备（好像每次击杀boss都会掉一件），传说装备很有趣，但还是希望普通装备在后期也能有自己的特色，类似小匕首拥有“背刺伤害增加”的专属词条，棍棒拥有“攻击几率眩晕敌人”的专属词条（希望目前版本已经有了，只是我没玩到）。 敌人都是血量又厚，伤害又高，这里分享下我个人的体验： 因为游戏没有中文且文本较多，我又想玩得轻松一点，于是我技能、装备和遗物一直都是随便凑的，直到打到血蜘蛛，才感到真是又刮又折磨。 意识到游戏的难点来了，我也决定认真玩一玩。我仔细看了看身上的装备，发现带有“火焰增伤”词条的装备明显居多，因此我决定玩以火焰伤害为主的流派。在开始旅程前重新配了下装备，将一切与火焰伤害挂钩的装备带在身上，在关卡内遗物也尽量拿与魔法伤害或是火焰伤害相关的，凑出了一个类似自走棋里的“羁绊”，随后很快打败了血蜘蛛。 最后也有个特别明显的缺点，那就是手感问题，操作起来比较僵硬难受，比如攻击的时候不能跳跃来取消，有时候无法在跳起来的时候顺畅按出空中攻击，希望制作组赶紧优化下吧

What can I say about Dragon is Dead after 1,5 hrs? Well, it has potential to be good if not great, but there's a lot of things missing or must be improved. There's a pretty sprawling skill tree, the artifacts mechanic is really cool and you can feel the impact of it in combat, the loot system is similar to Diablo games. The art style is good, but the overall look of the game is a mess, it's not finished and not polished without distinct look and cohesion in terms of art, level design, characters etc. The movement is not good, stiff and clunky, combat is basic and there's no distinct animations for various weapon types. The dialogues are not voiced so you need to read a lot of text. The music is good and reminds me of Diablo II, but there's really nothing else to create the atmosphere. I'm not sure if I like losing all the upgrades and skills after death, there must be at least some kind of checkpoint between different biomes which will save all the skills you acquired. Unfortunately, I can't recommend the game at its current state. Maybe wait 5-6 months to see if anything I've mentioned was improved / added or not.

First impressions video cut from a few hours of streaming the game: https://youtu.be/wxFiunEJ24E FULL SHORT (6min) REVIEW here: https://youtu.be/wqiapI--kVw First of all the trailer make it seem it's something like blasphemous or last faith, it's not. It's diablo with it's camera flipped and jump and dodge buttons added. Diablo itemization, the skilltrees are copied from d4 even aesthetically. The game looks dynamic but encourages standing in place and spamming attacks like you would in an arpg. The controls feel a bit clunky because it's lacking animation cancels after most actions making attacks delayed, being stuck in a dodge and very sluggish air time.

Edit to my previous review: It has cooked a bit and received a few updates, but it hasn't improved to the point where I could recommend it. It now has more animations for different weapons, but that's about it. If you're looking for a Metroidvania with rogue-lite features, then this isn't the game for you. It may look similar to Castlevania, but that's where the similarities end. Atm it feels VERY uninspired and bad, sadly. In this state, I can't recommend the game. It's not that it's bad, but it wasn't ready for EA. The combat NEEDS more fluidity. The fact that there is a 1 to 2 second delay after most actions makes most situations more tedious than fun. The bosses are not really fun either. The first boss could've been more fun with a bit less health and maybe 1 or 2 more attacks. If you have 3 heads and only 3 attacks, then give each head its own attack. OR give the boss 1 more attack to make the rng nature of it make sense. The 2nd boss has a similar issue. Items and skills are also very underwhelming for the fact that they are supposed to make every run feel different. When I equip different weapon types, I'd like them to at least FEEL different if you can't give them different animations. Equipping a sword, dagger or mace has you swinging a sword in the same way every time. As soon as those things are fixed or at least touched on, then I'll come back and check it out. Maybe even change the recommendation status. The game has potential, so I'll keep following it for sure.

I will update this review upon further early access updates and at full release however in its current state I cannot recommend this game despite WANTING to like it. [h2]Gameplay:[/h2] There are a LOT of bugs some of which I go over in other sections but some are game breaking like a dodge bug in which your dodge simply fails to go off, with the game saying it’s on cool-down. Well you can’t beat the game without dodging so GG. You can get stun locked by some spells in which you can’t even dodge out of after the first attack lands be it via a boss multi-hit attack or multiple enemy attacks coming in staggered Movement feels a bit off due to spell interactions and how dash is handled via the characters direction vs input direction. [h2]Items:[/h2] There are only a handful of items in the game, and within that handful only a few make an impact. Yes you can “enchant” items but it’s not worth it. [h2]Artifacts:[/h2] This is where the game gets most of the things right but I think they need better interactions and or more impactful ones. No rare/hidden synergies just WYSIWYG. [h2]Attacks/Skills: [/h2] [b]YOU CAN’T USE ANY ATTACKS OR SPELLS IN THE AIR. WTF! [/b] This needs changed immediately, it feels terrible and they even nerf the jump attack but don’t allow you to use anything else in the air but dodge… Skills need heavily re-balanced and buffed. While you want to try a variety of builds and spells/skills due to how bad some are be it because of animations, lack of synergy or just bad numbers. Also often times skills just "vanish" based on actions or movements when cast. [h2]Enemies:[/h2] Enemy reactions are very inconsistent, sometimes they don’t know you are there, other times they unpredictably face the opposite direction and attack. Enemy animations don’t match up with hitboxes. Enemy variety is VERY low right now and if often feels like a trudge to go from 1 area boss to another and the only time you have to think is when a huge wave spawns and you’re in the middle of it. [h2]Bosses:[/h2] For the most part they feel alright, some need some difficulty increased or perhaps more abilities… but they are pretty forgettable right now.

It's a very early access. I doubt anyone can really find the game super enjoyable at this state. Main problems for me: - clunky combat: completely unclear when enemies attack while you attack them and when not. Ranged attacks don't work when in the air, when you take damage it goes all really bad, you can't jump or dash at times, and the damage piles up. With the given attacks the combat just feels very much like a chore now. -loot balancing: really bad loots, and really poor availability of items - Incorrect language in many areas Would be also cool if the gears would affect how the combat animations and looks are, I assume this comes later. My suggestion: wait that they finalize the game before buying. A lot needs to be done still. In the meantime, go for Blasphemy that costs at the time of writing 7$

I am writing after having gotten to the end of story content that was available. What the early access offers is really promising, a platformer heavily inspired by Diablo. Each of the 2 characters has multiple different skills per break point that they can spec into, with legendary equipment that alters or improves how said skills can perform. These skills can be changed once during a run, and are entirely reset at the end of a run. Gear obtained during a run is carried over between runs, and can be either used, sold, or stored at home base. Artifacts can be obtained during a run and offer stat bonuses, with larger bonuses being offered if artifacts share affinities [h3]Pros[/h3] - Combat is simple but engaging - Combat is broken up into multiple small zones within a larger area, giving you time to breath after an encounter - The skill trees offer a lot of versatility when paired with the artifact system - Character and enemy design is immaculate [h3]Cons[/h3] - Various small glitches and issues throughout, nothing game breaking, but the occasional audio or visual glitch can be jarring - Later enemies have true combos, and it can feel unfair to have to deal with them when there are multiple enemies on screen - Plot dumps begin early, and happen often. At a certain point I was mashing to get through them without reading because of the sheer amount of lore that gets dropped all at once as opposed to being bled out over multiple interactions or areas - I can't find a way to report bugs or balance issues I come across [h3]Conclusion[/h3] This game is 100% worth the price tag currently, and I can't wait to see what it will become with improvements. Edit on November 1, 2024: Removed one of the cons, as a patch removed the issue

终极♂内容更新了，我也来更新一波评测。 我只想说 不愧是棒子游戏，是懂什么叫刷到肝部炸裂的。 我说的就是铁匠那个栽种。刷词条需要海量的资源，如果你刷神话装备词条，更是要用到新出的紫色碎片资源，而这种玩意儿的产出量很少，必须打通一次新模式才能获得，如果你中途暴毙了，那么本轮收益为0，而层数高了之后，boss的伤害是极其恐怖的，一击秒了你不是不可能，在此教个小窍门，要是感觉这把不行了赶紧alt f4，就可以重新开始当前关卡，如果你死了再alt f4就太晚了，我试过死后1秒之内alt f4，还是被送回了营地。 然后是bug，现在有个比较要命的bug就是铁匠刷词条存在货不对板，比如说，显示某个词条的范围100-200，即理论上你能刷出的数值在100到200之间，但实际上，我屡屡刷出过几十甚至十几乃至几，大冤种了属于是，本来刷词条的资源就极其宝贵，还给我整这出，焯！ 哦对了有个小tips，无论哪个角色，都刷点敏捷词条，因为100敏捷相当于10暴击+10闪避，可以节省很多词条位置，而且高等级装备敏捷上限是200，你刷个一百六七十已经很赚了，把暴击和闪避顶到上限再说。 这就要引出我下一个观点。。。。对这个游戏使用炎拳。。哦不对，使用修改器吧，单机游戏本来就是自闭爽的，我赌5包辣条现在排行榜前几的那几位肯定是修改器大佬，不然根本不可能刷到很多有用的词条，除非他们真的不要肝了在那里疯狂肝资源而且运气还爆棚几下就刷到高数值的有用词条。当然如果我错了，欢迎排行榜前几大佬当我面甩我一句：你怎么这样凭空污人清白 最后 猎爹天下无敌 我目前看到的伤害是冰狼拱一下1600w，一次可以拱好几下，我只想说 非常好狼狼，让我的牛牛爽飞天 正式版上线了，更新一波。 经过若干轮更新，神话甲的屏障倍率不生效bug还是没修，虽然可以用脱了重新穿的方法暂时修复，但是。。凭啥给玩家增添这种无妄蛋疼操作？？ 猎爹天赋里加屏障持续时间的那个被动也是选择性失效。 但这些都不影响猎爹秒天秒地秒空气。 但这也不是bug不修的理由。 箱子里拖东西消失的bug修复了。 装备词条无效的bug也修了，但似乎没有完全修，但已经可以很爽了，开局技能等级就10+，md谁敢杀我？？ 玩起来感觉和之前差不多，增加噩梦难度等级后，掉落的装备等级也变高了，基本就是调高难度后每轮去刷点更强力 的装备，就能打过了，打过后商人卖的东西的装等也会上升。 橙装还是一如既往的抽象，有用的极少。 碎片需求量极大，让我有开老金的冲动。 补票上车的，游戏时间25小时左右 总的来说，虽然游戏目前存在各种各样的问题，但。。。它就是莫名的好玩。对于一款游戏而言，这已足够。或者说，各种各样的问题还不足以让这游戏变得不好玩。 优点说完说问题 虽然看似物品技能五花八门，但目前而言可行的build非常有限，我个人目前摸索出的，两个职业都是普攻流，魔剑士的冰剑和酷似嘎子的狂战士的割裂。大部分橙装哪怕有一点卵用也不至于一点卵用也没有。神器多样性和可行性还算不错，但每次游戏还是有点看脸的，你凑出了好用的神器套装效果，那就是爽局，你要的套装效果迟迟出不来，那就是刮痧。 墓地那个boss似乎无视闪避？我六十多的闪避他每次攻击必中，不知道搞什么飞机。 有些神器的套装效果无效，比如四叶草的6件套。 游戏英文文本乱七八糟，文本里逻辑错误或是语义莫名其妙的情况比比皆是。很多玩家抱怨说没中文，我这么说吧，用这种文本翻译出来的中文，大家别做过高期待就对了。举个例子，有个装备描述是 敌人身上每有一种dot，你对其造成伤害就提高x%，且敌人受到的伤害降低x%，好家伙搁着套娃呢？先增伤再减伤，是不是有大病。

honestly the more you play the more awful everything feels. cant find the legendary youre looking for? thats cause the game's RNG gave you the *same* legendaries like 9 times in a row. have a tanky build? everything and anything can perma stunlock you until random stuff kills you. bonus points: you have large dodge and damage reduction but your dodge fails to trigger on any of the 19 hit combo youre about to receive and your damage reduction is just good enough to absorb all 19 hits before dying. lots of synergies and relic options to choose from but most of the time youre so heavily limited by the RNG that you wont ever complete anything anyway. stat systems and talent systems that feel super duper boring and bland. some stuff feels required (especially if you have legendaries focusing on specific elements / skills) but also heavily requires getting good relics and relic synergy to fully function. this leaves you with half a build at all times; and hardly ever feeling like you can competently complete a build during a run. enemy placement and enemy movement is a massive chore to deal with; especially into later levels. if you dont get the synergies / relics you need to just offscreen / oneshot everything--youre going to be in for a terrible time. auto homing ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥; "elite" mobs with auto homing / auto spawning damage auras and spikes and bombs and abilities. it becomes extremely unfun to engage with; and the balance is somewhere between 'you easily oneshot and coast through all levels and bosses' and 'you didnt get what you need and the entire run feels awful and you can barely keep up with the damage needed to advance through levels.' THERE IS POTENTIAL but it honestly feels like these devs are never, ever going to hit that potential. i hope they do! but it really doesnt seem like this game is ever going to make it.

- This is the worst Engrish I have seen in a game in a very long time. Gameplay is tight but I can barely understand what the writing is trying to convey at times, and it's riddled with mistakes that Microsoft Word would have pointed out with a simple proofread. - Game is pretty unoptimized. Just moving side to side in the screen can cause some lag/delay. (I'm running an I9-9900KS at 5.4 ghz with a 4090 Trinity OC - my rig is definitely not the issue here.) - At the end, when I was done, I went to "Quit" and it said "Progress is saved when you quit the game, you really want to quit?" and I went, "Yeah, duh". Then it put me back to the main menu. That's not the point of quit - the point of quit is "Hey, close this game". Thing is, is the save ONLY triggered upon usage of "Quit"? If I alt+F4'd would I have just lost all my progress? - Lack of tooltips is annoying. I have no idea what the stats actually do - you would think STR would increase HP or damage, but there was no difference to either. - Training dummies are nice but a poor substitute to actual data to provide to the player (see previous comment) I'm overall not impressed with this game. The name itself was pretty weird but I liked the premise. Unfortunately it's just not for me. Am I nitpicking? Maybe. But I can't help but think, if these glaring issues were not identified and resolved, then what might I be missing that would evolve with more gameplay? I'd give this an average 5/10 any day of the week as it's nothing special. This is fully released, not early access, and I'd expect a polished product. This dragon surely is quite dead. Let it lie.

Excellent little fusion of Diablo-style loot acquisition and roguelike metroidvania, which is a fairly unique combo. It's a fun ride that you can jam through pretty quickly and it has a lot of modern systems to ensure players don't get too locked into ruts regarding gear progression. There some faults among the positives, though. ---Pros--- Artwork: Probably what attracted your attention to the game, same as me. The pixel art on display is incredible, and it maintains that throughout the title. While it does lose a small amount for the procedural generation inhibiting level design, I really can't find anything to complain about here; it's just an amazing looking game. Loot: It has the fun addictive qualities of getting good drops and has many unique items to add additional affects to your skills. There are also a number of systems that let you add or reroll stats, craft legendaries using more basic gear for further stat selection, and a bunch more besides. It definitely helps you not get completely screwed by bad rolls. Controls: It plays very well, all attacks are responsive, the dodge feels fluid, and using a controller (as the devs recommend) all of the keybinds felt super natural and were easily rebound for those who want to change them around. ---Cons--- Level design: There basically isn't any. Every zone from start to finish is essentially a series of linked arenas with some good background art. There's no secrets to discover, paths to take, or anything else you might consider metroid-y. It's a highly linear experience that just assumes you're here for combat and nothing else. Music: It's not awful, but no single track stayed in my mind at all and the hub music is painfully reminiscient of Tristram from the OG diablo. Not every town needs mournful string instruments to remind me I'm playing a grimdark fantasy epic. Story: It can't decide if it wants to be dark souls or not, with a lot of characters rattling off terms and names from the get-go with nary a glossary in sight. Eventually you will piece together what's going on, and maybe there's more with repeated nightmare difficulty runs, but I wasn't impressed. No moments stood out to me and there are no characters I'll remember for more than a week. ---Summary--- If you want a fantastic-looking combat experience with both solid roguelike elements and gear-chasing, then this game will be right up your alley and will almost certainly give you great bang for your buck. If you prefer more narrative driven experiences or games with a more robust world then you might look elsewhere. I'd still recommend to pretty much all fans of the genre though.

Sadly cannot recommend this game, as much as I was excited to play it from early access footage and the supposed concept of the game. (1) Firstly, this is not a metroidvania meets roguelite. There are no metroidvania elements at all; the player does have a dodge, double jump, and air dash given right at the start but these are used mostly for combat rather than exploration and traversal (2) The game world is incredibly dull. I understand that the developers were going for a dark fantasy feel but the design is overall very lacklustre; music is uninspiring and boring and the same track was used for so many stages/ biomes (3) Gameplay in the end boils down to having hordes thrown at you and bullet hell. There is not an ounce of combat strategy or tactice. Characters do not stand out from each other in terms of mechanics and skills; skills are similarly boring and there is not enough for build customisation (4) I don't expect much of a plot here but the writing is abyssal. NPC speech is too wordy; everyone sounds the same (character design and art is pretty good though) Game was sent for a refund.

感觉又是像棒子的游戏，表面看着不错，打斗也还行，要素看着多，实际玩的时候就感觉哪哪都差点意思，装备掉落绝大部分都是无用的，就等着打boss掉传奇装备，装备改造也整的不痛快，还只能修改一个词条，这类游戏就是为了玩着爽啊，享受打造出极品装备然后割草的快感，结果不管是装备掉落还是装备打造都是样子货，各种遗物也是很难凑成导致我玩了十几把只有一把遗物凑成功了，技能升级很多 提升都很小，第三关开始就感觉打不动怪了，还有第三章的boss跟个多动症一样，攻击间隔小，攻击范围大，就一回靠着魔剑士的盾耗过去的，用狂战士打了七八次还是没法打。总之跟棒子的绝大数这类游戏一样都是固定套路换个皮，靠着好的美术坑人，内容做的让你刚好能爽完两小时然后无法退款，实在不推荐，同类型还不如去玩《星界战士》，内容不比这丰富多了，还更爽快！ 垃圾游戏，越想越气，这么好的底子，美术这么棒，为啥制作人跟傻逼一样，啥啥都有啥都不精通，技能设计跟傻逼一样，一点研究的深度都没有，装备掉落除了金装及传奇装备，其他都是垃圾，你又没有poe那样的装备打造系统，搞这个有啥用，打小怪基本就i没掉落过传奇装备，全是boss掉落，真他妈鸡肋。

通了15，全成就被两个bug卡住了。一个是初见最终boss的成就无法完成，一个是魔剑士5无法完成（可能因为拿的是狂战士的神话单手剑，导致系统以为是狂战士角色通的关）。 开局一小时以为是rogue游戏，后来发现其实是纯纯的刷子游戏，装备决定一切，神器倒不是特别重要。所有的关卡版面都不会变，每一次的体验其实是完完全全一样的。三个角色，15难敌方血攻数值双爆炸的情况下能通关的套路在现阶段的装备支持下基本只有一条路，虽然技能树看着很大，但是其实是根据装备词条来选择技能的，所以其实玩家的选择已经被限制死了（这点倒是跟暗黑3后期一模一样）。 目前碰到的几个恶性bug： 1铁匠重铸的后两个功能部分数值没有实装 2无论是中翻还是英翻，技能说明都存在严重谬误，比如把“全技能+3”写成“受到伤害减免+3” 3成就无法完成 4装备属性和神器套装属性无法即时生效，需要切换地图甚至重开 5公告中的狮心腰带没有实装，无法获取。导致腰部最高品质只有稀有 其他还有一些诸如不选择对应超越强化的话人物会被小怪一套连死之类的影响体验的设定，总之目前来说管这个游戏叫1.0是名不副实的，毕竟甚至连结局都没做。 总的来说，中下评。 6.12日更新了超绝补丁，保留了无法完成“初遇最终boss”成就的传统，并将神话掉率提升了-90%以解决新用户毕业过于迅速的bug。魔剑士和狂战士的难度5通关成就依然还是反的，狮心腰带依然没有实装，装备的“击中附加脆弱”词条依然无效。神话装备可以逆向做成传奇装备的良性bug也还在，并且会隐藏继原装备的全部特效，不知道是忘了改了还是留给玩家的后门。现在玩家强度倒是秒天秒地了，但是一个配装游戏，看到的词条跟实际作用效果不符其实是很致命的缺陷。
其他我什么都能接受，玩法和机制什么都可以，唯独！！！唯独！！！！你这个索敌系统拿脚做的？？对飞行单位索敌范围跟他妈贴脸有什么区别？我打教皇得蹦起来 一刀一刀蹭，我打飞行小兵也是得蹦起来一刀一刀蹭，而且空中攻击只有他妈一段？？？？？？？？？？？？？？？？？？？？？？空中攻击只有一段啊！！！打教皇BOSS一刀一刀蹭怎么想的，空中小兵后期血量尤其精英怪你让我蹦起来贴脸摸，跟送血有什么区别？

As much as I had hopes for this game, I can't recommend it after having the 1.0 release 1 year after I first played it. -There is an enormous amount of bugs -Almost no content got added except a final boss and NG+ with terribly overstatted enemies -The devs have 0 responses towards the community over the last year -A lot of content is copy pasted with a spin on the art from Skul and Blasphemous -The roguelite gameplay look isn't really fun, upgrades are mostly stats from items. The RPG item/looter aspect gets really boring really fast -The gameplay loop is long and unsatisfying to restart over and over since you are overstatted for the early game anyway because of how items work -Abilities are kinda same-ish and most status effect have 0 effect on bosses -Clearly the devs put almost no work into the game in the past 1 year, which makes me believe there won't be any fixes for all issues stated above in the near future I really hope I can recommend this game in the near future if the devs actually start working on the game instead of seemingly working on it for 10 minutes a day or fully abandoning it after 1.0. But as it is right now, I just can't recommend it and you should honestly just go buy the games it's clearly based off of.

[h1]Dragon Is Dead: A Surprisingly Solid Platformer[/h1] [b]Dragon Is Dead[/b] truly shines where it counts: the [b]gameplay[/b]. The mechanics are [b]excellent and highly responsive[/b], making every jump, dodge, and attack feel precise. As someone who's not usually a fan of platformers, I was genuinely impressed; this game is [b]far above average[/b] in its execution and kept me hooked. The [i]story is strongly average[/i] – serviceable, but forgettable. It's more of a backdrop for the fantastic platforming action. Honestly, I spent more time enjoying the smooth movement than trying to follow the plot. Despite the lackluster narrative, the game's strengths more than compensate. The excellent mechanics and addictive gameplay loop make it incredibly enjoyable. [h1]Key Points:[/h1] [b]Gameplay:[/b] [u]Excellent[/u], responsive, and satisfying. [b]Mechanics:[/b] Work [u]superbly[/u]. [b]Story:[/b] [i]Strongly average[/i]. [b]Platforming:[/b] Highly enjoyable, [b]far above average![/b]

玩了几天了，发评论时42h，三个角色都打过了噩梦6，总结来说是好玩的，能玩，手感还行，构筑偏少，但是感觉很多内容像是还没做完。 1.装备明显感觉很多都没做出来， 魔剑士3种附魔没有火系副武器，6个核心技能唯独霹雳一闪没有对应的传说主武器； 狂战士的传说武器被动都很奇怪，锯齿刃被动里句号隔开的“命中流血目标增伤”词条只对撕裂附魔生效，但狂乱之刃里句号隔开的“基础技能增伤”却是整体生效，而且狂战士有好多个能回血的技能，概率和数值给得奇低就算了，8件武器和其他所有装备里都没有一件是有关回血的； 猎人四种附魔火电毒之外的物理系似乎被制作组抛弃了，11件传说主武器里只有1件是物理侧的，神话级投矛词条还锁的是“魔法伤害”； 总体装备来说，神话级装备每个位置最多只有一件，太少了，腰带位没有传说和神话级，鞋子和魔剑士、猎人的副武器没有传说级，狂战士副武器位虽然能拿魔剑士的神话锤子，但是4个词条有3个是完全废掉的；而且狂战士传说武器很少，猎人和魔剑士都有11件传说主武器，狂战士单双手武器加一起才8件，魔剑士传说单手武器对狂战士来说拿不了也没被动 2.词条解释错得离谱， “受到的伤害减1”我切语种看了半天都没看懂这个“1”到底是什么计量单位，实测发现真实解释应该是“已加点技能等级加1”； “受到伤害后的免疫持续1”这个我就真没看懂，我只知道我被连续飞弹命中后仍然没有一刻的霸体或免伤； “压制伤害”我刷词条刷出来加成467%我还愣了一下，这个伤害我怎么从来没见到哪里有解释过，乱翻的时候才在“背包”→“角色属性”→“攻击”分栏的最后一条看到了“压制伤害”的解释，解释里说“技能命中带有护盾的敌人时有50%触发”，但是我实测发现是“角色带有护盾时命中敌人有50%概率触发”，因为我在营地打稻草人靶子的时候打出了紫色的伤害数字，稻草人没有盾，但我开盾就能打出来； 还是关于“护盾”，神话级锤子被动是“释放护盾技能时有10%概率召唤多把毁灭之锤打击敌人”，实测也是角色自己带盾时打中敌人时触发，而不是开护盾触发。 3.部分不知道是BUG还是什么的神奇机制 吞普攻（基础技能）。玩的时候经常放不出基础技能，后面试了才发现，一直按住对应技能键时，地面是技能连发，跳起来正常衔接，但落地前如果没有完整打出去基础技能的话，落地那一刻会重新计算基础技能的前摇，表现为我拿猎人空中已经做出投矛动作但丢出去之前落地，会在落地后不投矛并重新开始做投矛动作，但如果在空中已经投出一矛后的第二下投矛动作落地就能够正常衔接整个普攻动作，闪避打断普攻前摇也是一样 强化近战普攻（基础技能）在空中使用又不强化了。狂战士锯齿刃效果是“撕裂打击变为2段打击，并且范围和伤害增加。命中流血敌人获得额外增伤”，实测跳起来之后就变成了单段打击、基础双剑的小攻击范围和低伤害，但是撕裂打击的流血和锯齿刃的命中流血目标增伤又正常触发。更好笑的是，那个吞普攻的情况，落地前瞬间打出普攻的话，能看到空中小劈一刀后落地批出了强化普攻的第二段，衔接的那么丝滑我都不确定是BUG还是机制了。 受击后的硬直大得离谱，被连续命中根本没法躲，什么技能都按不出来，空中硬直完落地也还没缓过来还在硬直，也没办法取消。 4.神器协同感觉少了点什么 冰火电毒流血四个附魔里唯独缺少毒的神器协同种类； 神器协同里，基础技能有“元素”、核心技能有“野兽”、精通技能有“涅槃”，辅助技能和终极技能都没有对应协同，只有“平静4”有一个减15%终极技能冷却 还有，为什么我魔剑士通关噩梦8的时候跳出来的是狂战士成就？？？？？？

总体评价及简介：游戏让人眼前一亮。游戏的rouge部分类似（小骨），遗物通过羁绊进行提升威力。游戏职业系统目前3种（狂战士，魔剑士，猎人），通过不同技能加点走不同流派（例如魔剑士走冰，电，火三种流派）。剧情方面中规中矩，恶魔入侵背景下末日奇幻故事。操作方面，人物的动作比较流畅，对怪物的打击感不错的，boss的设计还可以。 创新之处：相比rouge游戏通过局外的天赋树的进行提升的传统模式，引入装备系统作为局外的成长。可以通过刷不同词条装备游玩不同的流派。武器里包括流派专武，相同的流派下也存在不同专武（专武与技能系统进行联动）。武器等级取决于通关的进度，通关的节点越长，武器的等级越高。游戏里推出了武器盲盒系统，通过开盲盒的形式开出高品质的装备。 缺点：只玩了魔剑士，感觉角色的对空性能较弱。刷装备的过程较为枯燥，每局死亡后，获得的金币会全部消失，前期盲盒系统不大行，建议金币可以保留。游戏尽管可以锻造装备，装备的材料获取刷很多遍游戏。建议增大对boss材料的爆率，能不能出材料商店进行购买。

游戏还可以，动作流畅，装备多，技能多，本质上是个刷装备的游戏。说几个缺点。 1、要打高难度梦魇15，必须刷神话装备然后洗词条。神话装备掉率太低了，不到1%，只能花费材料随机抽。但抽神话和洗词条太耗材料了，每局通关材料给得很少，想爽的建议后台修改材料。 2、比起神话装备，神器、灵魂宝石作用都不大，不用强行凑羁绊。 3、游戏内BUG很多，但不影响通关。翻译上错误也比较多，比如技能描述、装备词条描述等，估计没怎么测试匆忙上线了

先感谢好友送我的这个游戏。 20小时的游玩时间后，基本上可以下一个结论了——这游戏依旧是个半成品。 由传奇装备带来的技能强化，但依旧有大量的空缺传奇装备，比如魔剑士副手至今只有2个，又比如压根没有传奇的腰带部位。基本上一下子就能看到作为“刷刷刷”游戏的终点，这样会让人失去大量动力。 作为轻度肉鸽，这个“轻度”也太轻了一些，目前为止只有1个结局，终点永远是地图上分叉点前的那个点，而分叉点后面的内容依旧完全没有。 大量奇妙的BUG，即使制作组这里敲敲，那里敲敲，但还是有大量BUG。比如神话装备可以敲成传奇装备，敲完的成品即使没有写，但依旧保留了神话装备的效果，但似乎会在（也许是脱下来后）（也许是换角色后）失去这个效果。魔剑士冰属性的两个技能后续特效都会不知道为什么经常发挥不出来。 手感看起来很好，但是实际游玩的时候还是会发现大量会影响手感的小细节。空中平A时手感永远怪怪的（特别是落地的时候），猎人平A投掷自带的自瞄角度奇怪到一种奇怪的程度，好在玩家的强大属性弥补了这一点。 虽然画面看起来真的很棒，像素风格非常完美，每个BOSS都能看出来是精心设计过的Sprites，但依旧是个需要回炉打磨很久的游戏。鉴于这游戏带来的好一段爽快时光，我会先保留这个好评。
这游戏的职业定位和技能 是最接近于我心目中的 魔剑士 剑与魔法的融合 狂战士 嗜血狂暴的具现 女猎人 自然动物的元素 希望这游戏带来更多游戏内容

I have played this game since the beta and had a lot of fun with it, the story was somewhat interesting and the gameplay loop was fun, for a bit. The full release for it had come out and was excited to see what all had changed and added from the beta. All that changed was adding one character, and introducing the final boss. That's it. It would take an incessant amount of time to go through and grind to increase your gear level to be able to complete the game. I was also curious as to why they had abandoned their previous game "Blade Assault", and was hoping that there would be a plus side to them taking their time with this game. I wouldn't be surprised if they have ended up already abandoning this one as well to chase another game. I would not recommend this to anyone unless it is on sale and you are extremely bored.

This game tried to do what deadcells and skul: the hero slayer did, but failed at both, and it just made me want to go back and play skul again. The items (artifacts) are hard to get going because individually they are not strong enough and synergies are hard to get. The gear (weapons/armor) seems like a lot of the time does nothing aside from special legendary weapons that improve like 1 skill. They are also full of stats that seemingly do nothing. (e.g darkness resistance when there's nothing that does darkness damage, or if there is, the game doesn't show you). The skills themselves are not satisfying to use which is my biggest gripe with the game. Even after you unlock the 2 other playable characters that have distinctly different playstyles depending on the skills you pick, they still lack impact. Much like the atmosphere, the game also feels dead, and not in the sense that you're wandering dead forests full of...something that killed all the soldiers and stuff in darkness, it's the fact that the environment feels lifeless and the music feels too ambient to even notice it's there, the audio ques are poor and skills have next to no sound. In general, as of time of review, the game feels like it's not finished still and needed way more time in the oven.

Out of the way the art and general presentation is AMAZING. The Spellblade feels really fun and the core spells they have access to just feel near amazing to use. The design of the bosses feels grand and imposing, the last one especially. So why is this not recommended? The game has A LOT of issues. Nearly all the lore is dumped on you in the first 10 minutes sometimes with menus that appear with no warning and get skipped if you were doing anything before it came up. The other characters in the game are just randomly there with no introduction of what they do, which wouldn't be an issue but things to increase stats on different characters show up no mater what run you are doing. A lot of bugs that I feel minor but pop up a lot. The character can randomly bounce while landing which normally is fine but mid combat can just cause you to randomly be locked in the air during the bounce and take the damage. The skill points themselves very sadly feel same ish, especially fire and ice. There are only one or two mastery skills that are worth it. The ultimate for ice is just the master skill for fire. A lot of the skills are just do damage close by with an attacks while locking you into an animation. There is some but little reason to ever go from a single path which makes most of the items in the game just not usable. The game is just an inventory management for a good chunk of the game. Items being kept is nice in theory but it feels like so much more rng than other rogue likes and makes the early part of the game just slog to get through on repeat runs. Sadly at the moment this feels like it is trying a lot to be like Skul with a lot of its mechanics and presentation but doesn't have the versatility to currently back it up. For now the game is a pass but can polished out to fix a lot of issues I have with the game. With more spell/skill options and a bit more polish this could be a real diamond.

Solid game although short in content. The game excels in art: amazing designs and amazing animations. It also excels in gameplay with super sharp controls, and in build creation. With a very good variety of builds to try out. It's not perfect though, the game has little content and there is little variety for a roguelike, you will always see the same bosses, and you will most likely blast through them in a very short amount of time. In your first run you will likely get some OP legendary gear that you can carry to the next one. And one thing that really turned me off is the music is quite bland and generic, doesn't go well with the game. But all that said, the game is worth it. The art and controls really does it for me. You're in for a good experience.
